coverage_explanation: Exercises all three supplied target datetimes, successive inputs, repeated inputs, line and idle framing, and a near-day-boundary target. Assertions check the required D-{days} format. For fractional positive day differences, checks permit either adjacent whole-day result because the requirement does not specify rounding. API output checks cannot directly establish use of RTC_DS1307, begin(), or exactly one setup-time RTC read; the reference implements these explicitly.
assumptions: The supplied circuit establishes the DS1307 initial time as 2024-11-24T04:48:00. Harness support for this circuit state is a preflight prerequisite.
Preserve DS1307 SDA=A4, SCL=A5, VCC=5V, and GND=GND.2. No LED, button, or analog bench defaults are needed.
Serial uses the supplied 9600 baud and line-or-idle framing with a 20 ms idle timeout.
The setup-time RTC snapshot is captured close to startup, before the first serial target at 1000 ms.
Whole-day rounding is unspecified. Tests accept floor or ceiling for the positive fractional differences used here; the reference uses completed 24-hour periods.
RTC initialization failure behavior and malformed-target behavior are unspecified and are not asserted.
